research_rationale:
EO 12085 (Creating an emergency board to investigate a dispute between the Norfolk and Western Railway Company and certain of its employees), signed 1978-09-28. The order creates an emergency board under Section 10 of the Railway Labor Act for a dispute between the Norfolk and Western Railway Company and certain employees; Section 1-101 establishes a board of three members. First end: Section 3 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions) names this order by number, "Executive Order No. 12085," and provides that it is revoked. EO 12379 has no effective-date clause, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1982-08-17.
